confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Abu Dhabi price levels, not from inspected listings. Restaurant meal anchors are the most reliable. Beer and cocktail prices are less certain because alcohol is sold only in licensed venues and prices vary a lot by venue type. Hostel anchors are the least certain because Abu Dhabi has few hostels and dorm and private-room rates are thinly documented. Hotel rates reflect July, which is low season in the UAE, so they are lower than winter peak rates. The FX observation comes from a search result that attributes the 15 October 2026 AUD/USD figure to the RBA exchange-rates page; I could not open that page to verify it directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Gulf city pricing, benchmarked against Dubai and Doha with Abu Dhabi hotel rates set slightly below Dubai's. Restaurant and café prices follow UAE mid-market levels, including 5% VAT and typical 10% service charges where applicable. Alcohol prices reflect licensed-venue pricing.
